title: Promotion With a Prize
setup: Your pawn on d7 is one step from the last rank, and a black rook is standing diagonally ahead of it.
hint: Pawns capture diagonally, even on their very last step. Two rewards in a single move.
explanation:
## The Idea

A pawn's last step follows the usual pawn rules, diagonal capture included. Promoting straight ahead with {{d8=Q}} lets {{Rxd8}} take the new queen.

{{dxe8=Q}} captures the rook and promotes in the same move: five points taken and nine created, and the king on b7 cannot reach e8.

Before you push a pawn to the last rank, compare the straight step with the capture.
